zh:
Next.js

## 开始使用 全球一些大型企业使用 Next.js。它通过扩展最新的 React 功能，并集成基于 Rust 的强大 JavaScript 工具，帮助你创建全栈 Web 应用，以实现最快的构建。 - 访问 [Learn Next.js](https://nextjs.org/learn) 课程，开始学习 Next.js。 - 访问 [Next.js 展示](https://nextjs.org/showcase)，查看更多使用 Next.js 构建的网站。 ## 文档 访问 [https://nextjs.org/docs](https://nextjs.org/docs) 查看完整文档。 ## 社区 Next.js 社区位于 [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/discussions)，你可以在那里提问、发表想法并与他人分享项目。 如需与其他社区成员聊天，可以加入 Next.js [Discord](https://nextjs.org/discord) 服务器。 请注意，我们的[行为准则](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)适用于所有 Next.js 社区渠道。**强烈建议**用户阅读并遵守准则，以避免受到处理。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎并十分感谢对 Next.js 的贡献。但在开始之前，请先阅读我们的[贡献指南](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/61e1348fb523473db8cb3a6cfcadf7eefbf27d5f/contributing.md)，以便顺利参与 Next.js 的贡献。 ### 适合新手的问题： 我们整理了一份 **[适合新手的问题](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/labels/good%20first%20issue)**列表，其中的错误影响范围相对有限。这是新来者和初学者上手、积累经验并熟悉贡献流程的好地方。 --- ## 安全 如果你认为自己发现了 Next.js 的安全漏洞，我们建议你**_负责任地披露，且不要创建公开 issue_**。 如需参与我们的开源软件漏洞赏金计划，请访问 [https://hackerone.com/vercel](https://hackerone.com/vercel)。
en:
Next.js

## Getting Started Used by some of the world's largest companies, Next.js enables you to create full-stack web applications by extending the latest React features, and integrating powerful Rust-based JavaScript tooling for the fastest builds. - Visit our [Learn Next.js](https://nextjs.org/learn) course to get started with Next.js. - Visit the [Next.js Showcase](https://nextjs.org/showcase) to see more sites built with Next.js. ## Documentation Visit [https://nextjs.org/docs](https://nextjs.org/docs) to view the full documentation. ## Community The Next.js community can be found on [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/discussions) where you can ask questions, voice ideas, and share your projects with other people. To chat with other community members, you can join the Next.js [Discord](https://nextjs.org/discord) server. Do note that our [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) applies to all Next.js community channels. Users are **highly encouraged** to read and adhere to it to avoid repercussions. ## Contributing Contributions to Next.js are welcome and highly appreciated. However, before you jump right into it, we would like you to review our [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/61e1348fb523473db8cb3a6cfcadf7eefbf27d5f/contributing.md) to make sure you have a smooth experience contributing to Next.js. ### Good First Issues: We have a list of **[good first issues](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/labels/good%20first%20issue)** that contain bugs that have a relatively limited scope. This is a great place for newcomers and beginners alike to get started, gain experience, and get familiar with our contribution process. --- ## Security If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in Next.js, we encourage you to **_responsibly disclose this and NOT open a public issue_**. To participate in our Open Source Software Bug Bounty program, please visit [https://hackerone.com/vercel](https://hackerone.com/vercel).
